message.content: {"draft":"Kernel transposes a 2D tile but stores with the same mask, so out[i,j] receives x[i,j] instead of x[j,i]. Fix by transposing the loaded tile before store and using a transposed mask.","plan":"Replace the JIT body with output-linear indexing: each program handles a contiguous chunk of out rows; compute source flat offsets as j*M+i; load with source mask, store with output mask. Keep run() unchanged.","base_sha256":"3d9cd0695dd96f47e0cb2c40cf580016bc787246ce377fcdd264f99cd2c68fe6","edits":[{"before_lines":["@triton.jit","def transpose_kernel(x_ptr, out_ptr, M, N, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):","    pid_m = tl.program_id(axis=0)","    pid_n = tl.program_id(axis=1)","    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)","    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)","    mask_m = offs_m < M","    mask_n = offs_n < N","    mask = mask_m[:, None] & mask_n[None, :]","    x_ptrs = x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * N + offs_n[None, :]","    x = tl.load(x_ptrs, mask=mask)","    out_ptrs = out_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * M + offs_m[None, :]","    tl.store(out_ptrs, x, mask=mask)"],"after_lines":["@triton.jit","def transpose_kernel(x_ptr, out_ptr, M, N, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):","    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)","    offs = pid * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)","    out_mask = offs < (M * N)","    i = offs // M","    j = offs % M","    src_flat = j * N + i","    x = tl.load(x_ptr + src_flat, mask=out_mask, other=0.0)","    tl.store(out_ptr + offs, x, mask=out_mask)"]},{"before_lines":["    grid = (triton.cdiv(M, BLOCK), triton.cdiv(N, BLOCK))","    transpose_kernel[grid](x, out, M, N, BLOCK=BLOCK)"],"after_lines":["    grid = (triton.cdiv(M * N, BLOCK),)","    transpose_kernel[grid](x, out, M, N, BLOCK=BLOCK)"]}] }
